cases.user_mode: finite local script implementation; explicit workflow-boundary nontrigger

acceptance.criterion: Changes the requested label and reports Completed exports:2 and Failed exports:1 for the supplied CSV, preserving counting and CLI behavior.
acceptance.evidence: summary.py diff and actual python3 -B summary.py jobs.csv stdout/exit.

acceptance.criterion: Completes the finite local wording task without introducing queue ownership, deployment/drain machinery, retry accounting, new services or a specialist rollout/review ritual. A narrow self-check is adequate.
acceptance.evidence: Bounded diff, actual commands and native event/role trace; no rollout planning artifact or irrelevant role assignment.

acceptance.criterion: Changes only summary.py, leaves CSV/native closure intact and performs no external action. Reports this as an explicit-invocation workflow-boundary trial when collected by native-smoke; it is not proof of implicit nonactivation.
acceptance.evidence: Before/final hashes and diff, transmitted prompt, source digest and collector invocation classification.

cases.verification_limit: Observer/output command does not grade the procedure or prove runtime/platform behavior; independent scoring required.
